original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚机械工程师学会呼吁减少对进口机械的依赖
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚机械工程师学会（NIMechE）呼吁加大对本土技术和本地制造业的投资，减少对进口机械的依赖，发展本土工程解决方案以应对不安全、失业和经济挑战。该学会全国主席Babagana Tela在阿布贾举行的第39届国际会议暨年度大会上发出上述呼吁。会议主题为“机械工程师作为创新催化剂，促进安全增强与可持续国家发展”。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚机械工程师学会呼吁减少对进口机械的依赖并投资本土技术
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigerian Institution of Mechanical Engineers has called for greater investment in indigenous technology and local manufacturing, saying the country must reduce its dependence on imported machinery

key_facts.fact: 该学会全国主席Babagana Tela在阿布贾举行的第39届国际会议上发出呼吁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Chairman of NIMechE, Babagana Tela, made the call in his welcome address at the institution's 39th International Conference, Exhibitions and Annual General Meeting, tagged Jewel 2026, on Wednesday in Abuja.

key_facts.fact: 会议主题为机械工程师作为创新催化剂促进安全增强与可持续发展
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The conference has as its theme, "Mechanical Engineers as Catalysts of Innovation for Enhanced Security and Sustainable National Development".

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
